# Roberto D'Isanto

> Computer engineer, self-employed. I work across cybersecurity, software
> development and IoT/cloud systems; teaching and technical training have long
> run alongside my consulting work. PhD candidate in Information Technology and
> Electrical Engineering at the University of Naples Federico II. Based in
> Pozzuoli (NA), Italy.

This is the personal landing page. The full profile, with experience,
teaching, projects and downloadable CVs, lives under /curriculum-vitae/.
